display.purpose: KPI metric values, hero numbers — Follow the Money totals, Corruption Watch scores, Dark Money figures.

headline.purpose: Card titles and panel section headers (CardTitle component).

body.purpose: Supporting text, metadata rows, data labels, descriptive copy inside panels.

label.purpose: Band component text, section headers inside navy bars. Always uppercase with generous tracking.

micro.purpose: Source footers, chart axis ticks, timestamp meta, legal lines.

shadows.name: signal-glow
shadows.purpose: Hover/focus glow on orange-accented interactive elements only — CTAs and KPI cards.

motion.name: ease-out-fast
motion.purpose: Chart data entrance — elements decelerate into position.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.notes: Cards stack 1-up; nav collapses to hamburger.

components.name: Band
components.description: Full-width navy section header — opens every data panel. The system's structural signature.
components.css: .ds-band { background: #001A7A; padding: 7px 14px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; } .ds-band__label { font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 500; color: #FFFFFF; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-band__meta { font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif; font-size: 8px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45); letter-spacing: 1px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Default data container. Sharp-cornered, flat, 1px bordered, no shadow. border-top: none — Band provides the top edge.
components.html:
CARD TITLE

Panel content goes here.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #161616; border: 1px solid #272727; border-top: none; padding: 18px 18px 14px; } .ds-card__body { font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: #888888; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0; }

components.name: Card Title
components.description: Panel headline inside a Card — 19.5px Roboto 600.
components.css: .ds-card-title__h { font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif; font-size: 19.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #FFFFFF; line-height: 1.35; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-card-title__sub { font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: #888888; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary CTA. Signal Orange fill, 4px radius — the only softness in the system.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #FF8000; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; border: none; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #E67200; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255,128,0,0.15); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(255,128,0,0.6); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. Transparent with Border Steel outline; hover shifts to Signal Orange.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #888888; font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid #272727; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #FF8000; color: #FF8000; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(255,128,0,0.6); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Chart Tooltip
components.description: Inline data label on chart hover. 3px left Signal Orange border marks the active datum.
components.css: .ds-tooltip { background: #080808; border: 1px solid #272727; border-left: 3px solid #FF8000; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif; } .ds-tooltip__label { font-size: 9px; font-weight: 500; color: #888888; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 5px; } .ds-tooltip__row { font-size: 11px; color: #FFFFFF; display: flex; align-items: center; } .ds-tooltip__dot { color: #FF8000; margin-right: 5px; font-size: 8px; } .ds-tooltip__value { font-weight: 400; }

components.name: Accent Chip
components.description: Category label — Card Surface background, Signal Orange text, 4px radius.
components.css: .ds-chip-accent { background: #161616; color: #FF8000; font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 4px; padding: 4px 10px; display: inline-block; }

components.name: Source Footer
components.description: Citation line at the bottom of data panels — micro text, top border.
components.css: .ds-source-footer { margin-top: 10px; padding-top: 8px; border-top: 1px solid #272727; font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif; font-size: 8.5px; font-weight: 400; color: #484848; }

narrative.overview:
UNREDACTED is an open-source intelligence platform that exposes the money flows shaping American politics. Its visual system is built on one conviction: the data is the confrontation. Every panel is a briefing. Every chart is an accusation. Every number is evidence. The interface never decorates — it presents.

The aesthetic sits at the intersection of Bloomberg Terminal density and The Intercept's editorial credibility. Dark surfaces dominate (four near-black tones from #0D0D0D to #1D1D1D), carrying the gravity of a place where serious people track serious money. Signal Orange (#FF8000) functions as a signal flare — used on ≤10% of any screen, marking KPI values, live ticker text, and primary CTAs. Deep Blue (#0028AA) carries institutional weight in band headers and secondary data panels.

Inside panels, the layout follows Vodafone's editorial discipline — typographic hierarchy does the work, spacing is generous between sections and tight within cards, surfaces are flat with no decorative shadows or gradients.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first: four surface depths (#0D0D0D / #111111 / #161616 / #1D1D1D), all near-black
Signal Orange used on ≤10% of any screen — KPI numbers, CTAs, live ticker, accent marks
Deep Blue (#0028AA / #001A7A) for institutional band headers and secondary data panels
Zero border radius on cards — sharp-cornered surfaces throughout
Flat elevation: 1px solid borders carry hierarchy, no drop shadows
Roboto exclusively across all scales; weight and size do all the work
Band component opens every data section: full-width navy bar, 9px uppercase label, letter-spacing 2px

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Orange appears on ≤10% of any given screen. A dashboard where everything is orange is a dashboard where nothing is urgent. Reserve it for the moments that demand attention.

rules.name: The Dark Discipline Rule
rules.body: Never pure black (#000) or pure white (#fff). The four dark surface tones are a complete system — do not introduce new ones.

rules.name: The Single-Family Rule
rules.body: Roboto everywhere, always. No display serif, no mono accent, no second family. Weight and scale alone carry all hierarchy.

rules.name: The Uppercase-at-Label-Scale-Only Rule
rules.body: Uppercase with letter-spacing is reserved for Band labels (9px) and micro-labels. Headlines and body copy are always sentence case.

rules.name: The Tonal-Not-Lifted Rule
rules.body: Do not add drop shadows to cards, panels, or navigation. The four near-black surface tones create depth through tonal shift alone. Shadows imply softness — this system does not traffic in softness.

dos: Do use Signal Orange (#FF8000) on ≤10% of any screen — KPI numbers, primary CTAs, the live ticker, and chart tooltip accents.
Do open every data panel with the Band component — the navy header bar is the system's structural signature.
Do apply 0px border radius to all cards, panels, and containers.
Do use Roboto weight 700 for all metric and KPI values.
Do set border-top: none on Cards — the Band's bottom edge is the card's top border.
Do verify WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1) on all text combinations.
Do support prefers-reduced-motion for all chart animations and panel transitions.
donts: Don't use Signal Orange as a background for large surface areas — orange cards and panels are prohibited.
Don't add border-radius to cards or the Band component.
Don't add drop shadows to cards, containers, or navigation.
Don't use gradients on backgrounds, buttons, surfaces, or text.
Don't let the interface resemble USA.gov, Congress.gov, or FEC.gov — the aesthetic anti-references.
Don't use patterns that read as conspiratorial — red string, neon-on-black, wall-of-text layouts.
Don't introduce a second font family.
Don't use uppercase with letter-spacing above the Label scale.
Don't use pure black (#000) or pure white (#fff).
